packageRules.description: Runner image (`runs-on: ubuntu-latest`): changing it is a deliberate decision, never a Renovate pull request

All npm packages here are devDependencies (build and test tooling); only dist/ ships. Ranges in package.json stay as written; in-range updates only move yarn.lock. chore(deps): no changeset, no release
Dev dependencies: group minor and patch updates; majors come as separate PRs
OpenCode plugin SDKs (v1 @opencode-ai/plugin, v2 @opencode/plugin) define the plugin API this package is built against: every update is its own PR, never hidden in the group
prBodyNotes: **OpenCode plugin SDK update.** Check the OpenCode release notes for plugin API changes, run `yarn compile` and `yarn test`, and commit `dist/` if the build output changed (CI fails on a stale `dist/`).

packageRules.description: TypeScript can change the emitted JavaScript; dist/ is committed and CI fails when it is stale
prBodyNotes: **TypeScript update.** If the CI step "Check dist/ is up to date" fails, check out this branch, run `yarn compile` and push the updated `dist/` to it. Renovate cannot rebuild `dist/` itself.

packageRules.description: Yarn itself (`packageManager` in package.json; the binary is committed under .yarn/releases and referenced by yarnPath): its own PR
prBodyNotes: **Yarn update.** Check that this PR also replaced `.yarn/releases/yarn-*.cjs` and updated `yarnPath` in `.yarnrc.yml` to the same version as `packageManager`.

packageRules.description: GitHub Actions do not change the published package: ci(deps)
GitHub Actions: group minor, patch and digest updates (SHA pins and their version comments are kept); majors come as separate PRs
